name: Panther
description: A large feline predator that stalks its prey from the shadows.

abilities.name: Shadow Stalker
abilities.description: While Hidden, the Panther gains a +2 bonus to its attack rolls.

abilities.name: Pouncing Strike
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to have the Panther leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 1d12+2 physical damage.
